branchingCuttoon.page.title: Branching cuttoon
branchingCuttoon.page.intro: An experimental tool to build a cuttoon whose story branches when readers pick a choice, and to preview it.
branchingCuttoon.page.limitsNote: There is no server storage, reader statistics or settlement yet. Your story is saved only in this browser, so export it as JSON and keep a copy.
branchingCuttoon.page.replaceConfirm: Replace the current draft ({count} scenes)? The current content will be lost. Export it as JSON first if you want to bring it back later.
branchingCuttoon.page.appliedSample: Loaded the sample story. It reads without errors and includes one loop-back warning.
branchingCuttoon.page.appliedNew: Started fresh with just an opening scene.
branchingCuttoon.page.appliedImport: Imported the file with {count} scenes. Check the review results.
branchingCuttoon.editor.heading: Build the story
branchingCuttoon.editor.intro: Build scenes as a list and add cuts and choices to each scene. Select an item in the review results to jump to the place to fix.
branchingCuttoon.editor.emptyBody: Create an opening scene, or load the sample to see how it is structured.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockNodeLimit: You can make up to {max} scenes. Delete a scene you do not need and try again.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockChoiceLimit: Each scene can have up to {max} choices.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockCutLimit: Each scene can have up to {max} cuts.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockCutTableLim: You can make up to {max} cuts in total.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockNotFound: The item to edit was not found. Choose the scene from the list again.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockStartProtec: The opening scene cannot be deleted or retyped. Set another scene as the opening scene first.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockIdExhausted: A new identifier could not be created. Reduce scenes or cuts and try again.
branchingCuttoon.nodes.heading: Scenes ({count}/{max})
branchingCuttoon.node.heading: Edit scene: {title}
branchingCuttoon.node.startHint: The scene where the story begins.
branchingCuttoon.node.startCannotDelete: The opening scene cannot be deleted. Set another scene as the opening scene to delete this one.
branchingCuttoon.node.deleteConfirm: Delete this scene? The {count} choices that lead here are deleted too.
branchingCuttoon.cuts.heading: Cuts ({count}/{max})
branchingCuttoon.cuts.hint: Readers read cuts from top to bottom. For now cuts are text cards; linking images is a future goal.
branchingCuttoon.cuts.empty: No cuts yet. Add a cut to fill the scene.
branchingCuttoon.cuts.captionMissing: This cut is not in the cut table ({value}). Remove it and add a new one.
branchingCuttoon.choices.heading: Choices ({count}/{max})
branchingCuttoon.choices.hint: Readers press these at the end of a scene. Names must differ, and every choice needs a destination scene.
branchingCuttoon.choices.endingHint: Ending scenes have no choices. Leftover choices are hidden from readers, so delete them.
branchingCuttoon.issues.heading: Review results
branchingCuttoon.issues.allClear: Nothing to fix. Check the story in Preview.
branchingCuttoon.issues.summaryWarningsO: No errors, and {warnings} warnings to check. You can preview the story.
branchingCuttoon.issues.summaryErrors: {errors} errors to fix and {warnings} warnings to check. You cannot preview until the errors are fixed.
branchingCuttoon.issues.startMissing: There is no opening scene. Set one scene as the opening scene.
branchingCuttoon.issues.startDangling: The scene set as the opening scene was not found ({value}). Choose the opening scene again.
branchingCuttoon.issues.startKindMismatc: {title}: This scene is set as the opening scene but its type is not Start. Set it as the opening scene again from the scene list.
branchingCuttoon.issues.startDuplicate: {title}: More than one scene has the Start type. Only one opening scene is allowed.
branchingCuttoon.issues.nodeIdInvalid: {title}: The scene identifier format is not valid ({value}). Use up to 48 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
branchingCuttoon.issues.nodeIdDuplicate: {count} scenes share the same identifier ({value}). Give them different identifiers.
branchingCuttoon.issues.choiceIdInvalid: {title}: The choice identifier format is not valid ({value}). Use up to 48 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
branchingCuttoon.issues.choiceIdDuplicat: {title}: {count} choices share the same identifier ({value}). Give them different identifiers.
branchingCuttoon.issues.cutIdInvalid: The cut identifier format is not valid ({value}). Use up to 48 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
branchingCuttoon.issues.cutIdDuplicate: {count} cuts share the same identifier ({value}). Give them different identifiers.
branchingCuttoon.issues.choiceTargetEmpt: {title} · Choice "{label}": No destination scene is chosen yet. Choose a destination scene.
branchingCuttoon.issues.choiceTargetDang: {title} · Choice "{label}": The destination scene was not found ({value}). Choose a destination scene again.
branchingCuttoon.issues.cutRefDangling: {title}: A cut was not found in the cut table ({cutId}). Check the cut list.
branchingCuttoon.issues.choiceLabelEmpty: {title}: A choice has no name. Enter the text readers will press.
branchingCuttoon.issues.choiceLabelDupli: {title}: Two choices share a name ({label}). Give them different names.
branchingCuttoon.issues.textInvalidTitle: {title}: The scene title contains line breaks or invisible control characters. Enter the title again.
branchingCuttoon.issues.textInvalidLabel: {title}: A choice name contains line breaks or invisible control characters. Enter the name again.
branchingCuttoon.issues.textInvalidCapti: Cut {cutId}: The cut text contains invisible control characters or a disallowed line break. Enter the cut text again.
branchingCuttoon.issues.textInvalidGraph: The story title contains line breaks or invisible control characters. Enter the title again.
branchingCuttoon.issues.limitNodes: You can make up to {max} scenes, and there are {actual}. Reduce the scenes.
branchingCuttoon.issues.limitChoicesPerN: {title}: A scene can have up to {max} choices, and there are {actual}. Reduce the choices.
branchingCuttoon.issues.limitCutsPerNode: {title}: A scene can have up to {max} cuts, and there are {actual}. Reduce the cuts.
branchingCuttoon.issues.limitCuts: You can make up to {max} cuts in total, and there are {actual}. Reduce the cuts.
branchingCuttoon.issues.limitGraphTitleL: The story title can be up to {max} characters, and it is {actual}. Shorten the title.
branchingCuttoon.issues.limitNodeTitleLe: {title}: A scene title can be up to {max} characters, and it is {actual}. Shorten the title.
branchingCuttoon.issues.limitChoiceLabel: {title}: A choice name can be up to {max} characters, and it is {actual}. Shorten the name.
branchingCuttoon.issues.limitCaptionLeng: Cut {cutId}: Cut text can be up to {max} characters, and it is {actual}. Shorten the cut text.
branchingCuttoon.issues.nodeUnreachable: {title}: There is no way to reach this scene from the start. Point a choice from another scene to it, or delete it.
branchingCuttoon.issues.deadEnd: {title}: This is a dead end. It is not an ending but has no choice for readers to press. Add a choice or make it an ending.
branchingCuttoon.issues.endingMissing: There is no ending scene. Add at least one ending scene.
branchingCuttoon.issues.endingUnreachabl: {title}: No ending can be reached from this scene. Add a choice that leads toward an ending.
branchingCuttoon.issues.loopBack: {title} · Choice "{label}": This loops back to the scene "{target}". Readers can see the same scene again. Check that it is intended.
branchingCuttoon.issues.endingHasChoices: {title}: The {count} choices on an ending scene are hidden from readers. Delete them or change the scene type.
branchingCuttoon.issues.nodeTitleEmpty: A scene has no title. Titles appear in lists and announcements, so enter one.
branchingCuttoon.issues.cutRefRepeated: {title}: The same cut appears {count} times ({cutId}). Check that it is intended.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.heading: Export and import
branchingCuttoon.transfer.intro: Stories move as JSON files. Nothing is sent to a server; reading and writing stay on this device.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.exportHint: Turns the current draft into JSON as it is. You can export even while errors remain.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.exportedFile: Exported a file. Keep the downloaded file somewhere safe.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.exportedCopy: Copied the JSON. Paste it into a note or file to keep it.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.exportFileFail: The file could not be exported. Press the Copy JSON button and keep it yourself.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.exportCopyFail: Copying did not work. Press the Export as a JSON file button to get a file.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.importHint: Open a JSON file exported from this screen. If the shape is valid, it replaces the current draft.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.readFailed: The file could not be read. Try again or choose another file.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.importFailed: The import did not work. Check the file's shape and try again.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseEmpty: It is empty. Paste JSON text or choose a file.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseTooLarge: The file is too large. Only files up to {max} MiB are read. Check that it is an exported file.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseNotJson: It is not valid JSON. Check that it is an exported file.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseNotObject: The outermost JSON value is not an object. Check that it is an exported file.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseWrongForm: This is not a branching cuttoon file. Check that it was exported from this screen.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseUnsupport: This version number is not supported. Check that it was exported from this screen.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseWrongType: The {path} field has the wrong type.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseUnknownKi: The scene type in {path} is unknown. It must be start, scene or ending.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseTooManyIt: The {path} field has too many items.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseStringToo: The text in the {path} field is too long.
branchingCuttoon.storage.draftUnreadable: The saved draft could not be read, so a new draft was started. The old draft is replaced once you change something. If you exported a JSON file, load it with the import button.
branchingCuttoon.storage.saveFailed: The draft could not be saved in this browser. What you see here is unchanged. Press the Export as a JSON file button to keep a copy.
branchingCuttoon.player.heading: Preview
branchingCuttoon.player.intro: Read it the way readers will. Your place is saved only in this browser.
branchingCuttoon.player.emptyTitle: There is nothing to read yet
branchingCuttoon.player.emptyBody: Add scenes in Build, or load the sample.
branchingCuttoon.player.blockedBody: A story with {count} remaining errors cannot be previewed. Check the review results in Build.
branchingCuttoon.player.cutMissing: The text of this cut could not be read. Check the cut list in Build.
branchingCuttoon.player.endingHint: Start over, or step back and try a different choice.
branchingCuttoon.player.resetByChange: The story's paths changed, so you are starting over.
branchingCuttoon.player.saveFailed: Your place could not be saved in this browser. You can keep reading, and saving is tried again on the next choice.
branchingCuttoon.player.renderFailed: The preview could not be drawn. Please try again.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut1: Rain pours down on a narrow alley.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut2: The protagonist reaches into a bag for an umbrella and stops.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut3: At the end of the alley a stranger of a child stands in the rain.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut4: The child steps under the umbrella, looking startled.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut5: The child carefully shows a small key held in one hand.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut6: A few steps on, footsteps unlike the rain follow from behind.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut7: Looking back, the child is gone and only the streetlamp at the end of the alley flickers.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut8: An old number tag hangs from the key.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut9: The two walk in silence, sharing one umbrella.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut10: A letter written long ago is inside the locker. It bears the protagonist's name.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut11: At the door the child waves with a smile. Shoulders are soaked, but the heart is warm.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut12: Back home, the wet shoes come off. Outside the window the rain keeps falling.
branchingCuttoon.sample.choiceIgnoreBack: Go back to the alley entrance
branchingCuttoon.sample.choiceKeyLocker: Look for the locker on the tag
branchingCuttoon.sample.choiceKeyReturn: Give the key back to the child
branchingCuttoon.sample.choiceWalkEnd: See the child all the way
